Campaigns.Name: Campaigns
Campaigns.Label: Manage Campaigns
Campaigns.Hint: The Sending Stone app's address, and each campaign: its title, secret and player characters.

ChatEvents.Name: Send Chat Events
ChatEvents.Hint: Post chat messages as they are created, edited and deleted.

ChatScope.Name: Chat Messages to Send
ChatScope.Hint: Send each campaign every chat message its players can read, or only those spoken by one of its characters.

CombatEvents.Name: Send Combat Events
CombatEvents.Hint: Post combat tracker changes: encounters starting and ending, turns and rounds, and combatants joining, leaving, rolling initiative and being defeated.

GmContent.Name: Send Gamemaster-Only Information
GmContent.Hint: Also send what only a Gamemaster can see: whispers no player can read, blind rolls, hidden combatants, the hit points of combatants outside a campaign and the armor class of attack targets. Leave this off if players can see what the destination receives.

MidiIntegration.Name: Make Players' Attacks and Spells Through Midi-QOL
MidiIntegration.Hint: Players' attacks, spells and features from Sending Stone go through Midi-QOL's workflow, as if they had used them in Foundry: Midi checks the hit, rolls the targets' saving throws, and applies the damage, healing and effects, as you have it set up. Off: while Midi-QOL handles items' uses, players' attacks, spells and features stay in the app.

OffCanvasTargets.Name: Allow Targets You Aren't Viewing
OffCanvasTargets.Hint: A player's attack, spell or feature through Midi-QOL is made even at a target on a level or scene you aren't viewing. Its card names every target, but Midi can only check hits, roll saving throws and apply damage, healing and effects for tokens your screen shows; apply the rest from the card. Off: such a use is refused, and its player is told you aren't viewing their target.

Campaigns.Title: Sending Stone: Campaigns
Campaigns.Hint: Set up each campaign in the Sending Stone app first, then give it the same title and secret here. A character can be in more than one campaign.
Campaigns.NoCharacters: There are no player characters in this world.
Campaigns.None: No campaigns yet. Add one, then tick the characters in it.
Campaigns.TitleTaken: Each campaign needs a different title.
Campaigns.Rolls: Let Players Roll from Sending Stone
Campaigns.RollsHint: Checks, saving throws, initiative and death saving throws its players roll in the Sending Stone app are made here too, with the dice they rolled, as if they had rolled them in Foundry.
Campaigns.RollsUnavailable: Players' rolls from Sending Stone can't be made in this game: {reason}

RollsReason.system: they need the D&D Fifth Edition system.
RollsReason.self-test: this version of Foundry, or a module, rolls dice differently than Sending Stone expects. The browser's console says what went wrong.

Campaigns.Attacks: Let Players Attack and Cast from Sending Stone
Campaigns.AttacksHint: Attacks its players make in the Sending Stone app, and the spells and features they use there, such as Fireball, Cure Wounds or Second Wind, are made here too, at the targets they pick, with the spell slot, ammunition and attack mode they choose. The item is used as in Foundry, spending ammunition, uses and spell slots, and its damage or healing is rolled on the same use, all with the dice they rolled. Without Midi-QOL, you roll the targets' saving throws and apply the damage from the cards, as in Foundry; with it, Midi does. Needs Let Players Roll from Sending Stone.
Campaigns.AttacksUnavailable: Players' attacks and spells from Sending Stone can't be made in this game: {reason}

AttacksReason.self-test: this version of Foundry, or a module, rolls damage differently than Sending Stone expects. The browser's console says what went wrong.
AttacksReason.midi-off: Midi-QOL handles items' uses here, and Make Players' Attacks and Spells Through Midi-QOL is off in the module's settings.

Error.InvalidDestination: The Sending Stone address must be a web address, such as https://sending-stone.vercel.app.
Error.Network: the app could not be reached
Error.Timeout: the app did not answer in time

Notify.Failing: Sending Stone cannot deliver events to the app: {error}. Events are being dropped until it recovers.
Notify.Recovered: Sending Stone is delivering events to the app again.

Test.Ok: Delivered: the app answered HTTP {status} in {elapsed} ms.
Test.HintNetwork: Check that the address is right and the app is reachable from this computer, and that it answers the browser's CORS preflight (OPTIONS) request with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and Access-Control-Allow-Headers covering Content-Type and Authorization.
Test.HintMixedContent: Foundry is served over https but the app's address is plain http, which browsers block for any host other than localhost. Use the app's https address.
Test.HintAuth: The app refused the secret. Enter the secret set for this campaign in the Sending Stone app.
Test.HintNotSetUp: The app has no campaign with this title for this game. Set it up in the Sending Stone app with this game's address and the same title, then test again.
